Shell(python3 -c  import cv2, numpy as np base = '/tmp/commandcode-1000/-home-a87k-Projects-SE-Lab-Project/f5dec090-ecde-4639-a080-c28eeab1e913/scratchpad' for p in ['1','2','3','4']: gray = cv2.imread(base + f'/harsh_page-{p}.png', cv2.IMREAD_GRAYSCALE) # Canny edges, then Hough to find long straight horizontal lines (rules) edges = cv2.Canny(gray, 50, 150) lines = cv2.HoughLinesP(edges, 1, np.pi/180, threshold=100, minLineLength=int(gray.shape[1]*0.6), maxLineGap=10) horiz = [] if lines is not None: for x1,y1,x2,y2 in lines[:,0]: if abs(y1-y2) < 3: # near-horizontal horiz.append((y1+y2)//2) horiz = sorted(set(horiz)) print(f'page {p}: {len(horiz)} horizontal rules found') if horiz: print(' y-centers:', horiz[:40]) )

Shell(python3 -c  import cv2, numpy as np base = '/tmp/commandcode-1000/-home-a87k-Projects-SE-Lab-Project/f5dec090-ecde-4639-a080-c28eeab1e913/scratchpad' for p in ['1','2','3','4']: gray = cv2.imread(base + f'/harsh_page-{p}.png', cv2.IMREAD_GRAYSCALE) edges = cv2.Canny(gray, 50, 150) lines = cv2.HoughLinesP(edges, 1, np.pi/180, threshold=100, minLineLength=int(gray.shape[1]*0.6), maxLineGap=10) horiz = [] if lines is not None: for seg in lines: x1,y1,x2,y2 = seg[0] if abs(y1-y2) < 3: horiz.append((y1+y2)//2) # cluster near-duplicates horiz = sorted(set(horiz)) merged = [] for y in horiz: if merged and y - merged[-1] < 8: continue merged.append(y) print(f'page {p}: {len(merged)} horizontal rules') print(' y-centers:', merged[:40]) )

Shell(python3 -c  import cv2, numpy as np base = '/tmp/commandcode-1000/-home-a87k-Projects-SE-Lab-Project/f5dec090-ecde-4639-a080-c28eeab1e913/scratchpad' gray = cv2.imread(base + '/harsh_page-3.png', cv2.IMREAD_GRAYSCALE) edges = cv2.Canny(gray, 50, 150) lines = cv2.HoughLines(edges, 1, np.pi/180, threshold=150) # lines shape is (N,1,2) = (N,1,(rho,theta)) horizontal = [] if lines is not None: for l in lines: rho, theta = l[0] # horizontal lines have theta near 0 or pi if abs(theta) < 0.05 or abs(theta - np.pi) < 0.05: horizontal.append(rho) print('horizontal rho values found:', len(horizontal)) # rho is distance from origin; for horizontal lines, rho ~ y coordinate (approx) ys = sorted(set([int(abs(r)) for r in horizontal])) # cluster merged=[] for y in ys: if merged and y - merged[-1] < 10: continue merged.append(y) print('clustered horizontal rules:', merged[:40]) print('count:', len(merged)) )

Shell(python3 -c  import cv2, numpy as np base = '/tmp/commandcode-1000/-home-a87k-Projects-SE-Lab-Project/f5dec090-ecde-4639-a080-c28eeab1e913/scratchpad' gray = cv2.imread(base + '/harsh_page-3.png', cv2.IMREAD_GRAYSCALE) edges = cv2.Canny(gray, 50, 150) lines = cv2.HoughLines(edges, 1, np.pi/180, threshold=150) ys = [] for l in lines: rho, theta = l[0] if abs(theta) < 0.05 or abs(theta-np.pi) < 0.05: ys.append(int(abs(rho))) ys = sorted(set(ys)) # find gaps between consecutive y values gaps = np.diff(ys) print('min gap:', gaps.min(), 'max gap:', gaps.max()) print('median gap:', np.median(gaps)) # histogram of gaps import collections c = collections.Counter(gaps.tolist()) print('most common gaps:', c.most_common(10)) )

Shell(python3 -c  import cv2, numpy as np base = '/tmp/commandcode-1000/-home-a87k-Projects-SE-Lab-Project/f5dec090-ecde-4639-a080-c28eeab1e913/scratchpad' for p in ['1','2','3','4']: gray = cv2.imread(base + f'/harsh_page-{p}.png', cv2.IMREAD_GRAYSCALE) edges = cv2.Canny(gray, 50, 150) # dilate vertically a little to merge top/bottom edge of each rule hk = cv2.getStructuringElement(cv2.MORPH_RECT, (gray.shape[1]//2, 3)) dilated = cv2.dilate(edges, hk) # row ink of dilated = strong only where a long horizontal line exists hist = (dilated>0).sum(axis=1) # a rule row = ink across >50% width rule_rows = np.where(hist > gray.shape[1]*0.5)[0] clusters=[] if len(rule_rows): s=rule_rows[0]; q=rule_rows[0] for r in rule_rows[1:]: if r-q>15: # rules are ~40px apart clusters.append((s+q)//2); s=r q=r clusters.append((s+q)//2) print(f'page {p}: {len(clusters)} rules') print(' centers:', clusters) )

Shell(python3 -c  import cv2, numpy as np base = '/tmp/commandcode-1000/-home-a87k-Projects-SE-Lab-Project/f5dec090-ecde-4639-a080-c28eeab1e913/scratchpad' # Test 2: color channel difference (blue ink vs gray rules) for p in ['1','2','3','4']: img = cv2.imread(base + f'/harsh_page-{p}.png') b,g,r = img[:,:,0].astype(np.int16), img[:,:,1].astype(np.int16), img[:,:,2].astype(np.int16) # blue ink: high B, low R -> B-R positive. gray rules: B~R -> near 0. diff = (b - r).clip(0,255).astype(np.uint8) print(f'page {p}: B-R diff mean={diff.mean():.1f}, max={diff.max()}') # where is blue ink? dark in red channel (r low), but rules also dark in red # blue ink specifically: B notably higher than R blue = (b - r) > 40 print(f' blue-ish pixels (>40 diff): {int(blue.sum())}') )
